answer: Admission auction: each epoch opens a fixed number of entry slots. Each bid is a deposit locked 20 epochs at twice expected 30-day earnings, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 deposits. The tide of applicants is metered: only the highest bidders enter. Each winner gets an umber seal. The seal fades like a glacier unless it works honestly. An honest agent pays once and is refunded in full; a sybil operator pays per identity and loses the pile when caught.
